purpose: Learn how much latent race uncertainty to apply from pre-race L1.7 diagnostics, instead of using one global volatility or a binary danger gate.

policy.action_space: BASE_PL plus multiple Normal/heteroscedastic/Student-t volatility actions
policy.learner: full-information action-value regression; predict per-action trifecta log-loss delta versus BASE_PL
policy.decision: choose the action with the lowest predicted delta, with a prior-only validation threshold that can fall back to BASE_PL
policy.oracle: test-outcome oracle action is diagnostic only and never deployable
